{"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :-
1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC.
2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The note specifies heat treatment hardness but does not state the manufacturing stage at which it applies (e.g., after rough machining, before final grinding). Without a defined stage the machinist cannot sequence operations correctly, risking distortion of finished features. The designer should add when in the process the toughening is to be performed.","recommended_correction":"Revise N1 to specify the heat-treatment stage, for example 'TO BE TOUGHENED TO 24-32 HRC AFTER ROUGH MACHINING AND BEFORE FINAL GRINDING.'"},{"rule_id":"NM-008","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :-
1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC.
2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"Item 2 instructs retapping after surface treatment, yet the title block field 'surface_treatment' on page 1 reads 'N.A.', meaning no surface treatment is specified for this part. This is a leftover note from another drawing that introduces confusion and could cause unnecessary rework or cost. The designer should remove the inapplicable instruction.","recommended_correction":"Delete item 2 of note N1 because no surface treatment is called out on this drawing."}]}
